remarks: Welcome to this charming, fully renovated single-family raised ranch that combines modern living with comfort and convenience while being pet friendly! With 3 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms, and a spacious layout, this property is perfect for anyone looking for a cozy and functional place to call home. On the main level you'll find an open concept kitchen and living room as well as a full bathroom and two bedrooms. On the lower level you have a family room with fireplace, an additional bedroom, and a full bath and laundry area. Outside take advantage of the deck and plenty of private outdoor space. Attached garage and ample driveway space. You have the choice of having the home furnished or unfurnished.Make your appointment today! In order to move in you will need a credit check, as well as 3 months rent. No smoking allowed in home.
